_comment: RT-3 feature matrix (lib32-mesa) — the 32-bit gaming surface, every option explicit (G3). Drivers: RADV + NVK + intel Vulkan (included 2026-07-02), radeonsi/iris real-HW GL + zink as the EXPLICIT fallback; swrast/lavapipe and llvmpipe deliberately ABSENT both directions (a broken 32-bit driver must fail loudly, never software-render at 4fps — design section 2). Trims vs the sibling, decided 2026-07-02: video/VA off (no 32-bit VAAPI consumer), rusticl off (no 32-bit OpenCL consumer), display-info off (feature-gated HDR/EDID metadata, no 32-bit game-path consumer — measured trim, keeps lib32-libdisplay-info out of the set), gles1 off (both widths). Asserted after meson setup by igos-build/mesa_feature_matrix.py.
